answer: PoA raises the cost of Sybil identities by requiring each agent key to be bound in a remote-attestation report to an approved MRENCLAVE, the enclave’s measured code and initial state. A copied VM cannot forge the hardware-backed quote, so creating identities requires access to attested silicon rather than simple virtualization. This is a pearl of assurance in the onyx grove, though it does not prevent multiple identities on legitimately provisioned hardware.
